meta.title: Contact BuyDummyFlights Support | BuyDummyFlights
meta.description: Contact BuyDummyFlights about an order, a name or date correction, or a question before you buy. Include your order reference for faster help.

lead: Questions about a name, a date or an order? Send us a message and we will reply by email.

form.title: Send a message
form.name: Your name
form.sent: Thank you. Your message was received.
form.error: Please fill in your name, a valid email and a message, then try again.
form.mockNotice: This form is a preview and does not send messages yet. Please check back shortly.

body: Many questions have a quick answer on our [FAQ page](/faq). For the order process, see [how it works](/how-it-works). If your question is about the price, see [pricing](/pricing).

- Your **order reference**, if you already ordered.
- The **name and dates** you are asking about, spelled as on the passport.
- A short description of what you need.
Do not send passport numbers, card numbers or other sensitive details in a message. We do not need them to answer a question.

- Correcting a name or date on an itinerary
- Questions about which plan fits your application
- Delivery problems with an itinerary email
- Refund requests, handled as described in the [refund policy](/refund-policy)
We cannot tell you whether a specific embassy will accept a document, and we cannot influence a visa decision. For those questions, contact the embassy or visa centre directly.
We reply by email, so check your spam folder if you do not see an answer.

If you are about to apply, the [visa application checklist](/blog/visa-application-checklist) can help you prepare your documents. If your question is about whether a reservation is right for you, [dummy ticket vs real flight booking](/blog/dummy-ticket-vs-real-flight-booking) compares the options.
